a1
Jacob set out with all he owned. At Beersheba he offered sacrifices to the God of Isaac.
a2
God spoke to him in a vision: Jacob, Jacob. He answered: here I am.
b1
God said: I am the God of your father. Do not fear to go down to Egypt. I will make you a great nation there.
b2
I will go down with you, and I will bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.
c1
So Jacob left. His sons carried him, and their wives and children, in the wagons Pharaoh had sent.
c2
The chapter lists the family that came with him, seventy in all.
d1
Jacob sent Judah ahead. Joseph set out in his chariot to meet his father in Goshen.
d2
He embraced his father and wept a long time. Israel said: now I can die, for I have seen your face and you are alive.
h1
Jacob was old, heading for a land not his own.
h2
God told him: do not be afraid, I will go down with you.
h3
Many of us face a loss or a start we did not choose.
h4
Today, take one step, trusting that God goes with you.
i
What new beginning are you afraid of?
